title: ScholiaLang MCP 0.7.3 manual acceptance smoke (report-only)
authority: Execute an isolated, report-only acceptance smoke against the already integrated ScholiaLang-MCP candidate. No source edits, merge, deployment, PyPI publication, or Scholialang-cloud propagation is authorized.
problem: The cumulative candidate has unit, integration, and wire evidence, but Barry and Darren need one explicit no-op run that exercises the updated grammar/spec artifact and real stdio MCP Events, Tasks, and Heartbeat adapters together.
outcome: A durable acceptance report with command output and protocol captures proving (or clearly falsifying) the requested 0.7.3 grammar/spec and MCP feature paths on the exact cumulative integration tip.
evidence_contract: Record exact branch and SHA, package/spec fingerprints, commands, exit codes, stdio wire captures, default-off behavior, authorization/revocation behavior, task completion, event delivery, heartbeat renewal, and any caveats. Evidence is report-only and never a release signal.
hard_constraints: Run from integration/sch073-mcp-stage-base-20260906 at the pinned source tip; do not use stage or main.
Do not modify tracked source, grammar, spec, adapter, fixture, or test files.
Do not commit product changes, merge any branch, restart agent sessions, publish to PyPI, deploy, or propagate to Scholialang-cloud.
Use real subprocess stdio adapters and wire-level evidence; do not substitute unit-test claims for protocol execution.
Treat KB degradation or missing semantic prose as report-only caveats; the concluding evidence receipt and test results decide this smoke.
Sequential execution only; preserve all existing run artifacts and unrelated working-tree files.

stories.title: Verify the 0.7.3 grammar and spec artifact
stories.description: From a clean read-only checkout of the pinned integration tip, verify the Scholialang 0.7.3 package/spec fingerprints, grammar fixtures, and generated/packaged artifact contract using the repository's existing core073 and spec-fingerprint tests. Capture exact commands and results.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned 0.7.3 artifact and grammar/spec fingerprint checks pass
Exact SHA and test output are recorded

stories.title: Exercise real MCP Events, Tasks, and Heartbeat stdio
stories.description: Launch the existing real-adapter fixture as a subprocess and exercise authorized Events publication/subscription, Tasks submission/progress/completion/cancellation, and Heartbeat renewal/expiry behavior over stdio. Also verify default-off behavior, malformed routing-key rejection, reconnect/idempotency, and revocation denial. Use tests/integration/test_real_adapters.py and the repository's targeted protocol tests; preserve wire captures.
acceptance_criteria: Events, Tasks, and Heartbeat wire evidence is present
Default-off and authorization/revocation boundaries are explicit
No production host, HTTP, PyPI, or Cloud claim is made

stories.title: Produce a merge-review evidence receipt
stories.description: Write a report-only receipt containing branch/SHA, package and grammar fingerprints, commands, exit codes, capture paths, changed-file check, caveats, and a clear PASS/PASS_WITH_CAVEATS/FAIL verdict. Do not alter source or merge anything.
acceptance_criteria: Receipt is durable and independently reproducible
Changed-file check proves no product source mutation
Any caveat is non-blocking or explicitly named

verification: Run targeted grammar/spec tests plus tests/integration/test_real_adapters.py and related protocol regression tests from the pinned integration tip; inspect wire captures and git diff; independently adjudicate the run.
rollback: No product rollback is required. If run artifacts are malformed, discard only the report-only run record; preserve the integration branch and its existing backup refs.
